steps: Wash the spinach well and chop it roughly, tender stems included.
Melt butter in a pan and let the cumin sizzle.
Add garlic, ginger and onion and cook until the onion is soft but not brown.
Add the tomato and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the spinach and stir until it wilts down.
Pour in water, simmer for 5 minutes, then let it cool a little.
Blend until smooth, pour back into the pan and add water if it is too thick.
Season with salt and pepper, bring to a boil and finish with a swirl of cream.
note: I kept it a simple home soup thickened by the spinach itself, with no flour and no milk, and cream only as a finish. 100 g spinach makes one good bowl.
